label: Verizon CR1000A
description: Verizon Router CR1000A, the Wi-Fi 6E Fios gateway with a 10 Gigabit Ethernet WAN port, one 10 Gigabit and two 2.5 Gigabit LAN ports, and a coax port running MoCA 2.5 LAN for set-top and extender backhaul. Radios are three 4x4 802.11ax bands (2.4, 5 and 6 GHz) with SON band steering, and the box handles NAT/NAPT, ACL firewalling, IGMP, IPv4/IPv6 dual stack and TR-069/TR-181 management.
notes: Datasheet hardware configuration: 'One 10 Gigabit LAN port', 'Two 2.5 Gigabit LAN ports', 'One 10 Gigabit WAN port', 'Coax port supporting MoCA 2.5 LAN'; Wi-Fi 'One 2.4 GHz 11ax 4x4', 'One 5 GHz 11ax 4x4', 'One 6 GHz 11ax 4x4', internal antenna, 20/40/80/160 MHz, DFS, WPA2/WPA3; 'IP sharing for LAN with up to 253 users'; 'NAT and NAPT', 'Virtual Server and DMZ', 'Firewall function with Access Control List (ACL)', IGMP, 802.1P/Q, TR-069/TR-181, HTTP embedded web server. Scope correction worth flagging: the CR1000A is the Fios gateway, not a 5G FWA unit - it is included because a 10G WAN port plus 2.5G LAN plus MoCA 2.5 is exactly the multi-rate edge a lab cannot otherwise build. USB Type-C port not modelled; no CLI, management is web/TR-069 only, so cli is not claimed.
